name: ASHWA RACING
description: Established in 2003 under the Ashwa Mobility Foundation, Ashwa Racing is one of India's premier collegiate motorsports teams with consistent national and global Formula Student participation spanning over two decades. Ashwa Racing carries a string of national firsts. We fielded India's first-ever Formula Student entry at FSAE Australasia in 2005, and the same year produced Asia's first Formula Student vehicle at that event. In 2014, we became the first Indian team to build both a Hybrid and a Combustion car in a single race season. In 2017, we became the first team in Formula Hybrid history to clear Mechanical Inspection on the first attempt!
